    StartersPortuguese kale soupSmooth potato soup with kale and smoked sausage, olive oil on topHow to make it600g potatoes1 brown onion1.2 L chicken stock1 bunch kale200g smoked sausage2 tbsp extra virgin olive oilSimmer the potatoes and onion in the stock until soft, then mash smooth.Shred the kale finely and slice the sausage.Add both and simmer.Drizzle with olive oil.Pizza parlour garlic knotsBaked pizza dough knots tossed in garlic parsley butter and parmesanHow to make it500g pizza dough60g butter3 garlic cloves1 bunch parsley30g parmesanRoll the dough into ropes and tie each in a knot.Bake at 220°C until golden.Toss straight away in melted garlic butter with parsley and parmesan.Lobster boat garlic chilli prawnsThe lobster boats in the harbourHow to make itAs written, serves 4Prawns sizzled in butter, garlic and chilli, splashed with white wine and lemon, finished with parsley and served with crusty bread to mop up.Heat 60g butter and 2 tbsp olive oil in a large pan.Add 5 sliced garlic cloves and a chopped red chilli and cook 1 minute.Add 600g peeled green prawns and cook 2 minutes, turning.Pour in 80ml white wine and the juice of a lemon and bubble 1 minute.Toss with chopped parsley and serve in the pan with a sliced baguette.MainsLeona's secret sauce pizzaThin crust with honey oregano tomato sauce, mozzarella, linguiça and peppersHow to make it1 tin crushed tomatoes2 garlic cloves1 tsp dried oregano1 tsp honey1 pinch chilli flakes500g pizza dough250g mozzarella150g linguica1 green capsicumSimmer the tomatoes with crushed garlic, oregano, honey and chilli.Stretch the dough thin and spread with sauce.Top with mozzarella, sliced linguica and capsicum.Bake on a hot steel at maximum heat.Jojo's wedding clam and chorizo bakeJojo's wedding, after she faintsHow to make itAs written, serves 4Clams, prawns, new potatoes and corn steamed in a big pot with white wine, garlic, butter and chorizo, tipped onto the table with lemon and bread.Boil 600g new potatoes for 10 minutes in a big pot and drain.Fry 200g sliced chorizo in the pot, add 4 sliced garlic cloves, then 250ml white wine and 60g butter.Add the potatoes, 4 halved corn cobs, 1kg clams and 500g green prawns in the shell.Cover and steam 6 minutes until the clams open.Tip onto a table lined with paper and serve with lemon wedges and bread.SweetsPortuguese custard tartsFlaky pastry shells filled with blistered cream custard, dusted with cinnamonHow to make it1 sheet puff pastry4 egg yolks300ml thickened cream100g caster sugar1 lemon1 tsp ground cinnamonRoll the pastry into a tight log, slice into 12 and press into a muffin tin.Whisk the yolks, cream, sugar and lemon zest.Fill the cases and bake at 250°C until blistered.Cool slightly and dust with cinnamon.DrinksJojo's wedding day sangriaPortuguese red wine, brandy, orange, lemon and apple, chilled with cinnamonHow to make it1 orange1 lemon1 red apple750ml Portuguese red wine60ml brandy2 tbsp caster sugar1 cinnamon stick250ml lemonade1 bag iceSlice the orange, lemon and apple into a big jug.Add the wine, brandy, sugar and cinnamon stick and stir until the sugar dissolves.Chill for an hour.Fill four glasses with ice, pour in the sangria with some fruit and top with a splash of lemonade.
